title: Search expenses by note
pr_description: Adds search_expenses() so users can find expenses by note text, with a configurable sort column for the results.

defects.description: The sort column is interpolated into the SQL via an f-string. A caller-controlled sort value enables SQL injection; it must be validated against an allowlist of column names.
LIKE wildcards in the search text are not escaped, so searching for '100%' or 'a_b' matches unintended rows. % and _ must be escaped with an ESCAPE clause.
